## History

Grandma Irving is the grandmother of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and the mother of [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who left town after a past falling-out with Miss Lavendar. Her son later unexpectedly returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) finished her two-year term as the local schoolteacher. Following his arrival, Stephen reunited with Miss Lavendar with the assistance of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P0](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0000), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P1](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0001), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P6](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0006), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), +78 more_

## Relationships

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--paul-irving.md)

Grandma Irving is the grandmother of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) lives with her in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits him and his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), after Stephen returns to town. Grandma Irving cares for [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), who maintains a close relationship with both his father and his teacher, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

- Relative of — grandson  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), +5 more</sub>
